description:
A rare opportunity to make this 1940s-built home your very own historic masterpiece! Single level-no steps, 4 bedroom, 3 bath layout on a 23,109 sq ft -double lot in the coveted Encanto Palmcroft neighborhood. Home faces the Encanto Golf Course to the north and has ample space to add a guest house & a pool.
City living with parks, top-notch restaurants, and easy access to the I-10 freeway. A must see!
